announcement.title: The 2026-2027 Concert Season
announcement.body: Full season information and ticket details arrive later this summer. Be the first to know when the schedule is released.

donation.title: Help keep great music playing
donation.body: As a community band, the GRSB is largely supported by gifts from its members and audience. Donate $25 to $99 for a thank-you gift of concert tickets, or $100 and up to receive season tickets. You can even sponsor the chair of your favorite musician.
